description: Customer-service contacts (phone, chat, email, video), one row per interaction. Typed, normalized and checked from workspace.bronze.call_center_interactions. Event time is event_ts (issue 19); mentioned_products (issue 15) and contact_reason (identical to reason_category) are dropped. Outcome and sentiment fields are post-contact: never use them as model features (issue 16).

load.notes: Daily files partitioned by process_date. Incremental runs MERGE new Bronze rows by interaction_id.

interaction_id.description: Interaction identifier (INT- + 16 alphanumerics), trimmed and upper-cased. Primary key; referenced by call_transcripts and satisfaction_surveys.

event_ts.description: Contact start time (from interaction_date). The event time for every trend, split and recontact window.

event_date.description: Calendar date of event_ts. Use this, not process_date, for daily aggregates and temporal splits.

process_date.description: Business-day cut-off of the source system: the previous day for contacts before 08:00 (33.3% of rows), never a later day. Partition/pruning key only.

customer_id.description: Customer who made or received the contact (CLI- + 12 alphanumerics).

agent_id.description: Service agent who handled the contact (AGT- + 10 alphanumerics).

interaction_type.description: Contact type. Voice and video carry duration; only inbound calls carry wait time.

channel.description: Contact channel (85.0% Phone). Must agree with interaction_type (check channel_matches_type).

reason_category.description: Contact reason (Spanish, accents restored). Queja is the dispute-intake proxy. The dropped contact_reason column was an exact copy. Label-like: exclude from features of any reason or intent model.

duration_seconds.description: Handle time in seconds, only for voice and video (NULL for chat and email). Observed floor of 30 s, max 1,204 s.

wait_time_seconds.description: Queue wait in seconds, only for inbound calls (NULL otherwise). Observed 0-424 s.

was_resolved.description: First-contact resolution flag. Driven only by reason_category (section 2). Post-contact outcome: never a feature.

requires_followup.description: Follow-up flag. Rule-generated: always True when was_resolved is False, 14.98% of resolved contacts. Not a label.

was_escalated.description: Escalation flag. A flat ~10% in every reason, independent of resolution. Not a label.

detected_sentiment.description: Sentiment label. A binning of sentiment_score at -0.7 / -0.3 / 0.3 / 0.7 (either label at a cut point, since the score is rounded to 2 decimals); redundant with the score. Never a feature.

sentiment_score.description: Sentiment score in [-1, 1], 2 decimals. Post-contact: analysis only, never a model feature.

customer_detected_accent.description: Accent detected for the customer, lower-cased; NULL for 29.8% of contacts (same rows as agent_used_accent).

agent_used_accent.description: Accent used by the agent, lower-cased; NULL when no accent was detected.

has_transcript.description: True when a row exists in call_transcripts for this interaction (171,321 contacts).

has_recording.description: True exactly when duration_seconds is present (voice and video).

checks.name: interaction_id_format
checks.description: Identifier follows the INT- + 16 alphanumerics pattern.

checks.name: customer_id_format
checks.description: Customer identifier follows the CLI- + 12 alphanumerics pattern.

checks.name: agent_id_format
checks.description: Agent identifier follows the AGT- + 10 alphanumerics pattern.

checks.name: process_date_is_cutoff
checks.expr: process_date IS NULL OR event_date IS NULL OR process_date BETWEEN date_sub(event_date, 1) AND event_date
checks.description: process_date is the event date or the previous business day, never later.

checks.name: channel_matches_type
checks.expr: CASE interaction_type WHEN 'Inbound Call' THEN channel = 'Phone' WHEN 'Outbound Call' THEN channel = 'Phone' WHEN 'Email' THEN channel = 'Email' WHEN 'Chat' THEN channel IN ('App', 'WhatsApp', 'Web Chat') WHEN 'Video' THEN channel IN ('App', 'Web') END
checks.description: Channel is one the interaction type can use (calls by phone, chat by app/WhatsApp/web chat, video by app/web).

checks.name: duration_only_voice_video
checks.expr: (duration_seconds IS NOT NULL) = (interaction_type IN ('Inbound Call', 'Outbound Call', 'Video'))
checks.description: Handle time exists exactly for voice and video contacts.

checks.name: wait_only_inbound
checks.description: Wait time exists exactly for inbound calls.

checks.name: recording_matches_duration
checks.expr: has_recording IS NULL OR has_recording = (duration_seconds IS NOT NULL)
checks.description: has_recording is true exactly when a duration is present.

checks.name: followup_when_unresolved
checks.expr: was_resolved IS NULL OR requires_followup IS NULL OR was_resolved OR requires_followup
checks.description: Every unresolved contact requires follow-up (rule-generated field).

checks.name: sentiment_label_matches_score
checks.expr: sentiment_score IS NULL OR detected_sentiment IS NULL OR CASE detected_sentiment WHEN 'Muy Negativo' THEN sentiment_score <= -0.7 WHEN 'Negativo' THEN sentiment_score BETWEEN -0.7 AND -0.3 WHEN 'Neutral' THEN sentiment_score BETWEEN -0.3 AND 0.3 WHEN 'Positivo' THEN sentiment_score BETWEEN 0.3 AND 0.7 WHEN 'Muy Positivo' THEN sentiment_score >= 0.7 END
checks.description: The sentiment label is the bin of the score (cut points inclusive on both sides, as the score is rounded).

checks.name: accents_present_together
checks.description: Customer and agent accents are both present or both missing.
